description: Applies to repositories that are not publicly published as npm packages.

dos: Private repositories must apply private.json and set package.json private to true.

Documentation, workspace, and infrastructure repositories are expected to contain proprietary internal information, including private hostnames, usernames, filesystem paths, and access details; they must remain private.
Private repositories may publish authorized GHCR images without becoming npm packages.
donts: Private repositories must not publish npm packages or expose npm publication credentials.

Applying the private profile does not exempt a repository from plaintext-secret review. Encrypted secret payloads may be committed; plaintext secrets require a specific Eli-approved exemption record for the rule that reports them.

dos: After the seven general AGENTS.md headings, add a ## Private distribution section. Document private distribution restrictions, access boundaries, and non-public publication rules.
donts: Private repositories must not present public npm identity, public registry claims, or unrestricted deployment instructions.

dos: The .github/workflows/ci.yml workflow in a private repository must contain validation only. When ghcr-published is also applied, its separately authorized publication workflow may publish only on exact v#.#.# tags.
donts: Do not include publication or deployment commands, npm publication jobs, or publication credentials in .github/workflows/ci.yml. Do not publish from branches or pull requests.
